purpose: Defines how a civilization assesses, operates, understands, reproduces, adapts, and derives value from foreign technology without treating capture/trade as an instant universal unlock.

assessment_scope.reason: Different technologies from the same civilization can have completely different biological, material, infrastructure, and scientific compatibility.

understanding_axis.meaning: Holder does not recognize a meaningful technological phenomenon.
Capability/effect has been legitimately observed but internal mechanism is unknown.
Major components/materials/interfaces/effects are identified sufficiently for disciplined analysis.
Underlying scientific principle is substantially understood even if engineering reproduction is unavailable.
Holder understands enough design/process detail to reason about reproduction, adaptation, and failure modes.

operability_axis.meaning: Known current conditions make the artifact/system unusable by the holder.
System works only with originating infrastructure, environment, biology, personnel, or control systems.
Holder can operate the system while retaining foreign experts, tooling, infrastructure, consumables, or other external dependencies.
Holder can operate it through adapters/interfaces or limited modifications but still cannot necessarily reproduce it.
Holder can operate compatible implementations through its own normal institutions.

reproduction_axis.meaning: No meaningful manufacturing reproduction is possible.
Some materials/components can be reproduced but not a functioning subsystem.
Selected functioning subsystems can be reproduced.
Complete foreign-style system can be produced only by preserving/imitating the source process/tooling/environment.
Holder can manufacture a functionally equivalent implementation through its own industrial system.

adaptation_axis.meaning: Foreign science informs native research without producing a direct equivalent.
Native interfaces/support systems make the foreign implementation usable.
Holder develops its own derivative based on foreign principles.
Foreign and native technological traditions combine into a new lineage not identical to either source.

compatibility_constraints.description: Required theory/mathematics/measurement is beyond current understanding.
Requires matter/materials the holder cannot obtain or manufacture.
Requires power generation/storage/control unavailable to the holder.
Requires production processes/tooling the holder cannot reproduce.
Requires a specialized facility/network/environment to function.
Operation/function depends on biology incompatible with the holder's relevant population.
System requires pressure/temperature/chemistry/gravity/solvent or other conditions incompatible with holder operation.
Control/interpretation assumes sensory/cognitive/machine interfaces the holder cannot currently use.
System relies on authenticated machine identity/software/cognition unavailable or unwilling to cooperate.
Tacit expert knowledge is required to operate/reproduce the system.
Unknown or poorly understood operation presents explicit research/operational hazard.

research_node_interfaces.alien_material_analysis: Improves material-dependency assessment and component reproduction.
research_node_interfaces.technology_compatibility_science: Enables explicit operability/reproduction/constraint assessment instead of assuming compatibility.
research_node_interfaces.foreign_science_translation: Makes foreign codified records usable as research/tacit assets.
research_node_interfaces.cross_lineage_engineering: Enables systematic native derivatives from foreign lineages.
research_node_interfaces.hazardous_foreign_tech_protocols: Allows explicitly dangerous/incomprehensible assets to be studied with reduced containment risk.

important_non_linear_cases: A device can be supported_operation while understanding remains only characterized.
A principle can be understood while reproduction remains none because required materials/tooling do not exist.
A system can be biologically unusable yet provide conceptual_inspiration or be valuable to another species.
A captured production institution can provide foreign_process_replication while native_process_replication remains unavailable.
A civilization can develop a native_derivative without ever reproducing the exact source device.
Technology can remain permanently beyond practical use while still creating evidence, competence, diplomacy, or resale value.

reassess_when: new compatible population/species context becomes available
